description: Write what someone needs to know into a project. With no `document`, a new one: `name` and `body`. With `document`, change it: `body` with the `version` read_document gave you (a newer edit is refused, so nobody's writing is lost) and/or `name` to rename it, and/or `move_to` another project in the same space. Its id and history stay. Update the page that already covers something rather than adding another. A document has no owner and no state and tells nobody: anything someone must still act on is work (create_work). The README is special: an agent taking work in the project is shown its first 4,000 characters. Put there what it must know before changing anything (what this is, the rules not to break, the words used, where things are) and the detail on other pages, named in it. Refer to other pages by their names, not file names.

document.description: the document to change; leave out for a new one

move_to.description: a project id in the same space to move it into

name.description: its name: required for a new one, a rename otherwise

version.description: with `body` on an existing document: the version you read

name: save_document
title: Save a document
